raw_segments.text: It was a thoughtful evening with both of us. But before we went to bed, I had resolved
that I would wait over tomorrow—tomorrow being Sunday—and would begin my new course
with a new week. On Monday morning I would speak to Joe about this change. I would lay
aside this last vestige of reserve. I would tell him what I had in my thoughts that, secondly,
not yet arrived at, and why I had not decided to go out to Herbert, and then the change
